provenance_note: All client/vendor/human/address data excluded. Higher-ed vertical retained; copy structure only.

knowledge.plain_language_summary: A long, low, single-sided non-illuminated aluminum cabinet monument with a recessed brushed ID panel, crisp flat-cut aluminum primary and secondary letters, and a decorative reveal, carried on twin steel poles in augered footings. Dark bronze metallic body reads premium and permanent.
knowledge.rationale: A non-lit fabricated cabinet with mechanically fastened flat-cut letters needs no power runs and stays field-serviceable (removable back skin, nuts from behind); dark bronze plus a brushed recessed panel signals institutional permanence.

structure.construction: 1.5x1.5x1/8in aluminum angle frame + 1/8in skins, corners welded/sealed except removable back panel (drilled #10-24x1/2in), painted dark bronze metallic
1in deep aluminum tube frame (1x1x1/8in) with 1x2x1/8in square-tube border, recessed brushed/dark ID field
flat-cut 1/2in plate aluminum, 1/8in SS studs, flush-mounted, nutted from behind
1in aluminum tube reveal welded to frame; 1.5x1.5x1/8in steel angle saddles on twin 4in dia Sch40 steel poles in 24in dia augered direct-burial 3000psi concrete footings to match campus standard

craft_observations: Mechanically fastened flat-cut letters with removable back skin = field-serviceable, no power.
Dark bronze body + brushed recessed panel + crisp flat-cut letters reads institutional and permanent.

aesthetic_notes.note: Restrained, monolithic, low-and-wide; appropriate to an academic department.

modeling_notes: Dominant archetype is the fabricated cabinet body; flat-cut letters are applied components.
